entries.title: Coal Echoes  |  First-Person Narrative Exploration Game
entries.meta: Aug–Nov 2026  ·  Solo Developer, Designer, Writer, and Environment Artist  ·  Unity 6, C#, HDRP, Blender
bullets: Designed four levels set in an abandoned coal washing plant in northwestern China. Wrote the grandfather's diary, the protagonist's scrapbook notes, and the ending.

Implemented a photography system that detects camera framing, a drag-and-drop scrapbook, and a playable cableway sequence. Shaped the surrounding terrain from real elevation data and used HDRP lighting, fog, and custom shaders to build the plant's atmosphere.

entries.title: Vanishing Fireflies  |  Interactive Light and Sound Installation
entries.meta: Jun 2026  ·  Solo Project  ·  Unity, ESP32, C/C++, Arduino
bullets: Built an installation in which visitor movement and directed light disrupt the flicker of simulated fireflies. Programmed the ESP32 to process radar and light sensor input and control addressable LEDs.
Connected the ESP32 to Unity over UDP so the same sensor input shifts the soundscape from nature toward city noise.

entries.title: Against the Current  |  3D Environment Study
bullets: Reconstructed a Three Gorges riverbank, wooden boat, and river trackers using historical and location references. Composed the scene around the towline to show how workers hauled boats upstream.
Developed cliff and riverbank materials and used height fog, lighting, and color grading to give the gorge depth.

entries.title: Desert Restoration Simulator  |  Land Management Game Prototype
entries.meta: Jan 2026  ·  Solo Developer, Gameplay Designer, and Art Director  ·  Unity 6, C#, URP
bullets: Designed and programmed a simulation in which mining, factory construction, and tree planting affect both the player's budget and the condition of the land.
Linked vegetation loss and industrial pollution to changes in dust, sky color, and heat distortion so players could see the environmental effects of their decisions.

entries.title: Coal Echoes 煤火回声  |  叙事探索游戏
entries.meta: 2026 年 8 月  ·  个人独立完成  ·  Unity 6、HDRP、C#、Blender
bullets: 以废弃洗煤厂为舞台，围绕已故爷爷的日记和一张 1980 年的合影设计四个关卡的第一人称探索体验，搭建摄影、相册、手账编辑与物品检视系统，实现通过相机发现物品的交互。
通过 Blender MCP，由 AI Agent 辅助完成索道、门卫室等工业资产的参数化建模与材质烘焙，并导入 Unity 场景。
基于 USGS 实测高程数据在 MapMagic 中搭建地形，并以 Gradient Terrain Authoring 离线求解地形过渡；在 HDRP 中实现沙尘、热浪与运行时报纸半调效果（半调算法改写自 Daniel Ilett，MIT）。

entries.title: Vanishing Fireflies 消逝的萤火虫  |  萤火虫交互装置
entries.meta: 2026 年 6 月  ·  个人独立完成  ·  ESP32、Arduino、Unity、UDP
bullets: 编程控制三组共 420 颗 LED，通过雷达与光照传感器捕捉参与者的移动与人为光源，映射为萤火虫灯群的扰动和同步行为。
实现两个独立感应区域与一组自然闪烁灯群，并提供开发调试用的 UDP 接口，可由 Unity 发送同步控制指令。
